study type: Systematic review of evidence and international guidelines
exposure: Planned caesarean section for term breech presentation
Planned vaginal breech birth for term breech presentation
cohort: Women with singleton breech presentation at term and their babies, as subjects of the reviewed studies.
finding: This systematic review found that while the Term Breech Trial initially shifted practice towards planned caesarean section, subsequent evidence suggests that planned vaginal breech birth can be a safe and reasonable option under strict criteria and with experienced clinicians.
mod_finding: The review found that planned vaginal breech birth, when strict criteria are applied and an experienced clinician is involved, can reduce perinatal mortality and is now advised as a reasonable option in many professional guidelines, challenging the previous recommendation for routine planned caesarean section.
